## What's new

- Added a backup system, which is enabled by default. Every time you save, a copy of the beatmap is saved in a "backups" folder in the data directory. Check the settings menu for more information.
- Added an option to add a 60ms delay to beatmaps, similar to the official editor. (disabled by default)
- Fixed timing points being created that would mess with the measure bars in-game
- Made camera preview even more accurate

**Happy mapping!**
